subject: general
question: Taxol is extracted from which plant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yew.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is the well-known natural-source cancer(Breast, lung, and ovarian ) drug in the USA and is one of the best plant-based treatments available.
 
• Taxol is obtained from the bark of the** Yew tree.**
 
• The process was invented by **Robert Holton** of **Florida State University** was licensed and developed to produce taxol by **Bristol Myer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is an evergreen timber tree of the yew family (Taxaceae) found from Alaska to California.
 
• It is given in combination with other chemotherapy medicines and is used post-surgery to reduce the risk of early-stage breast cancer coming back.
